output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.product_id) AS distinct_products_ordered
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.country = 'FR'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: The query counts distinct product_id values from order lines whose orders belong to customers with country 'FR' (dim_customers) and have an order_date in 2025. No status filter is applied, since the question counts orders of any status. Orders are linked to customers via customer_id and lines to orders via order_id. No personal-data columns are used.
